brief:
Political analyst Iyad al-Qara warned Gaza faces a critical phase following Israeli Defense Minister Yisrael Katz's threats to forcibly relocate one million Palestinians, Shehab Wire reported. Al-Qara expressed concern that intensified Israeli strikes could signal an institutional shift toward deportation as formal policy adopted jointly by the occupation army and government.

Katz's statements represent the latest in a series of high-level Israeli threats targeting Palestinian civilians in the enclave.
dek: Political analyst Iyad al-Qara warned Gaza faces a critical phase following Israeli Defense Minister Yisrael Katz's threats to forcibly relocate one million Palestinians, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Israeli defense minister's deportation threats herald dangerous escalation in Gaza
